tools.name: submittable_get_organization
tools.description: Get the organization that the API key belongs to: name, domain, account status and team capacity. Good first call to confirm the connection.

tools.name: submittable_list_projects
tools.description: List the organization's projects (calls for submissions) with their ids, names, start and end dates and live status. Use the `projectId` values in the other tools.

tools.name: submittable_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id: its name, dates, review stages, form ids and visibility settings.

tools.name: submittable_list_forms
tools.description: List forms (the submission forms of projects). Filter by form `type` or by `projectId`. Use the form ids in the form-entry tools.

tools.name: submittable_get_form
tools.description: Get one form by id: its name, type, fields and settings.

tools.name: submittable_list_submissions
tools.description: List submissions (one per submitter and project), with status, submitter name and email, title, labels and review stage. Filter by project, status, date and text. Submitter data is personal data: share it only as the user needs.

tools.name: submittable_get_submission
tools.description: Get one submission by id: status, submitter, title, labels, review stage and its form entries (the submitted answers and metadata).

tools.name: submittable_get_entry
tools.description: Get one form entry by id: the answers a submitter gave on one form (initial, additional, internal, review or reference). Set `includeDrafts` to see unsent drafts.

tools.name: submittable_list_form_entries
tools.description: List the completed form entries of one form (all submitters), one page at a time.

tools.name: submittable_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels the organization uses to tag submissions. Use the label ids in the submission filters.

tools.name: submittable_list_team_members
tools.description: List the organization's team members with their email, title, permission level and roles.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submittable_get_project, submittable_list_submissions, submittable_get_submission, submittable_get_entry, submittable_list_team_members · Private data: submittable_get_organization · Public sink: submittable_list_submissions, submittable_list_team_members.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submittable_get_project, submittable_list_submissions, submittable_get_submission, submittable_get_entry, submittable_list_team_members · Private data: submittable_get_organization · Public sink: submittable_list_submissions, submittable_list_team_members

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
